title: simbasjungles/free-my-tv
why_read: Another Android TV debloating/launcher tool, overlapping closely with similar projects in this list and offering limited unique technical insight.
analysis: This is yet another ad-free Google TV home screen replacement, notable mainly for being built using Claude Code as a development tool and including a one-button undo feature. The repeated appearance of multiple similar TV-debloating projects in this digest suggests a trend rather than unique innovation. It's a practical consumer tool but technically similar to other entries, offering little new to engineers beyond the development-with-AI angle.
